rationale: Greek δόγμα + Coptic ⲛⲟⲃⲉ 'sin' (capitalized per terminology guide as cosmic principle). Title of Kephalaion 121 and the polemical-doctrinal formula that the chapter examines. Distinct from glossary's ⲁⲟⲅⲙⲁ (general 'doctrine') by its specific reference to a named teaching attributed to the presbyter's school.

Compound: ⲣⲉϥ- ('one who does') + ϣⲙ̄ϣⲉ ('serve, worship') + ⲉⲓⲇⲱⲗⲟⲛ (Greek εἴδωλον). Standard agentive formation paralleling ⲣⲉϩ†ⲥⲃⲱ 'teacher,' ⲣⲉϩⲣ̄ⲛⲁⲃⲉ 'sinner.' Used here for the elderly presbyter representing the idol-cult that adheres to the 'doctrine of Sin.'

Reduplicated/extended form of a plucking-verb, likely Lycopolitan reflex of ϫⲱⲗⲕ̄ 'draw, pull, harvest' (cf. glossary ⲭⲱⲗⲕ̄/ⲭⲱⲗⲍ 'draw, draw up'). Confirmed by collocation in lines 29 and 33 with grape-vine and the harvest-time context. The reduplicated ⲭⲉⲗⲗⲉϩ may carry iterative aspect ('pluck repeatedly').

proposed_english: of the grape / of the vine
rationale: Lycopolitan ⲉⲗⲁⲗⲉ = Sahidic ⲉⲗⲟⲟⲗⲉ 'grape, vine' (Crum 53b). Recurs three times on this page (lines 31, 32, 33) in the agricultural-typological argument about which trees are deemed 'bitter' and what is 'plucked' from the vine. Standard Coptic agricultural term.
ⲧⲃⲱ 'tree, plant' + ⲛ̄ⲉⲗⲁⲗⲉ 'of grape' = grape-vine. Standard Coptic agricultural compound, directly attested in line 33: ⲛⲁⲭⲁⲗⲉϩ ⲍⲛ̄ ⲧⲃⲱ ⲛ̄ⲉⲗⲁⲗⲉ '(they) shall pluck on the grape-vine.'

proposed_english: the strong land / the hard land
rationale: ⲕⲁⲍ ('land,' Lyc. for ⲕⲁϩ) + ⲉⲧⲛⲁϣⲧ (qualitative 'be hard, strong'). Designates resistant/unyielding land in the agricultural register of this section. Possibly contrasted with the 'beautiful land' / 'bitter land' dyad in earlier kephalaia, here as a third category — the hard ground that bears bitter fruit.

Greek δόγμα. While glossary already has ⲁⲟⲅⲙⲁ for the same Greek source, this orthography ⲡⲇⲟⲅⲙⲁ retains the original δ. Distinguishable from homograph ⲡⲇⲟⲣⲙⲁ 'people' (= δῆμος) by orthography (ⲅ vs. ⲣ) and by context. Adds an attested orthographic variant to the corpus.
